protocol: Offscreen actual native SDF fragment module to F32 target with blending disabled only by a test dispatch wrapper; separate compute pipeline reads the same shape/outline bytes. Compare every raw32-bit component; no tolerance. Production shader/binary outputs not updated.
coverage: With HarfBuzz:562fixtures (256channel permutations,36gradient fixtures,270realGlyph fixtures over5glyphs/3scales/3gammas/6phases),9207808components/run. Direct and staged both exact. Negative control deliberately flips one alpha bit and must reject all2301952alpha components. Without HarfBuzz:292fixtures; same native/compute and negative checks.
limitation: This isolates pre-blend float sources on this adapter. It does not establish general RGBA8 fixed-function blend equivalence, texture parity, general output caching, foreground CPU nonregression or a completed renderer. Those gates remain open.
